verified_contracts: All three arms have one observed image, H native command rows and H-1 outputs. Future target features are used only in the loss/evaluator, never passed to predict.

The production recipe fixes 30 complete epochs, H60/59 supervised offsets, effective batch64, and all-window/all-offset training loss. No horizon truncation or graph detachment is introduced by the training loop.
Each microbatch loss uses actual microbatch sample count divided by actual optimizer batch count, including short tails; gradient clipping and optimizer step occur once per optimizer batch.

Validation runs with autocast and TF32 disabled. The selector is equal-trajectory endpoint offset59/H60 standardized MSE, strict earliest minimum; the training loss remains equal-window across all59 offsets.

Initial epoch0 state is authoritative before any update; resume restores model, optimizer, scheduler, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and DataLoader generator. Best-generation recovery follows authoritative last history.
CPU tests prove bit-exact 30-epoch interruption/replay with dropout, including first-epoch and best-before-last crashes; this is not evidence of bit-exact cross-hardware CUDA continuation.

All actual cache metadata opens use frozen registration/static identities, correct native command widths4/14/8 and training-only shared-channel normalization. Box/Rope statistics helpers receive task strings, covered by real-helper regression tests.

The evaluator scores all eligible internal-development windows, records all59 primitive FP32-computed error offsets as float64, recomputes H15/30/45 using causal prefixes, retains persistence and all signs, and checks selected H60 score parity.

The finalizer requires exactly27 distinct complete runs, reconstructs exact window populations and equal-trajectory curves from NPZ ledgers, checks selected checkpoint/recipe/source identities, and commits immutable completion under a lock.

No official-validation evaluation is authorized by this registration. Cache inventory metadata lists reserved official IDs, but review, training, profiling and development evaluation access only approved internal splits.
